exposure: microbes in the lower respiratory tract (LRT)
cohort: Preterm infants admitted to a single neonatal intensive care unit in Foshan, China, between January 2015 and December 2017 were included in the study.
finding: The lower respiratory tract microbes differed between infants with and without severe bronchopulmonary dysplasia, with Gram-negative bacteria being more frequently detected in sBPD infants.
